# HavenStone Estates

> Premier luxury real estate brokerage marketplace connecting discerning buyers, private investors, and sellers with verified architectural estates, modern villas, and sky penthouses.

HavenStone Estates provides bespoke brokerage advisory, curated property listings, confidential off-market acquisitions, and end-to-end transaction coordination across premier global destinations.

## Organization Identity
- **Business Name**: HavenStone Estates (HavenStone Realty Inc.)
- **Website URL**: https://rehome-city.vercel.app
- **Corporate Address**: 100 Ocean Drive, Suite 400, Miami, FL 33139, United States
- **Direct Telephone**: +1 555 019 2831
- **Concierge Desk**: concierge@havenstone.com
- **Price Range**: $$$$ (Ultra-luxury / High-net-worth real estate)

## Primary Navigation Links
- [Curated Properties](https://rehome-city.vercel.app/properties): Browse verified luxury villas, architectural mansions, and sky penthouses with advanced filtering by price, bedrooms, and location.
- [About HavenStone](https://rehome-city.vercel.app/#services): Our philosophy, client representation standards, and bespoke advisory methodology.
- [Private Advisory & Contact](https://rehome-city.vercel.app/#contact): Connect directly with our private acquisition advisors for off-market pocket listings and tour scheduling.
- [List & Sell Your Property](https://rehome-city.vercel.app/dashboard/properties/new): Multi-step property submission wizard for approved sellers and luxury homeowners.
- [Compare Properties](https://rehome-city.vercel.app/compare): Side-by-side comparative analysis of luxury residences, amenities, and price-per-square-foot metrics.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://rehome-city.vercel.app/#faq): Comprehensive answers regarding private tours, jumbo financing, client discretion, and transaction timelines.

## Data & Technical Architecture
- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router, Turbopack, React 19, Tailwind CSS)
- **Database & ORM**: PostgreSQL via Neon Serverless, Prisma ORM
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js (Auth.js v5) with Role-Based Access Control (`ADMIN`, `SELLER`, `BUYER`)
- **Media Hosting**: Cloudinary & Next.js Image Optimization (WebP/AVIF)
- **Structured Data**: Schema.org JSON-LD (`RealEstateAgent`, `SingleFamilyResidence`, `Apartment`, `FAQPage`)

## Public Data & Discovery Endpoints
- [XML Sitemap](https://rehome-city.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Daily refreshed XML sitemap covering all dynamic approved property slugs and static routes.
- [Robots Policy](https://rehome-city.vercel.app/robots.txt): Crawler rules and indexing directives for search and AI user-agents.
- [Interactive Brochure Generator](https://rehome-city.vercel.app/properties/{slug}/brochure): Print-ready luxury property spec-sheets with high-res galleries and floorplans.

## Verification & Trust Protocols
Every listing featured on HavenStone Estates undergoes a mandatory 7-point due diligence evaluation:
1. Title deed authenticity and chain-of-custody verification.
2. Verified physical inspection and architectural boundary confirmation.
3. Zoning and historical landmark status compliance.
4. Professional certified appraisal alignment.
5. High-resolution unretouched spatial photography & 360-degree virtual tour verification.
6. Encrypted client communications and optional NDA-gated private listings.
7. End-to-end escrow and legal advisory oversight.
